meta.title: Air remote (ESP32-C6)
meta.description: Turns a Waveshare ESP32-C6-Touch-AMOLED-2.16 board into a virtual microphone for DSH voice input. The board streams 16 kHz PCM over TLS/WSS; the official voice-input plugin transcribes it locally and writes the draft. Gyro mode drives the mouse through BLE HID, and the settings page flashes the bundled firmware and syncs the board clock and time zone. Use: install the bundle, open Settings → Air remote, flash the bundled firmware once, pair the board in Windows, then pick “Air remote (ESP32-C6)” as the voice input device. Board time and automatic time sync are in the same section. Limitations: flashing and reset need a Chromium-based browser on a Windows host with Web Serial; voice needs the board's WSS link and the official voice-input plugin; a second computer must pair once, after which the board reconnects automatically and flashing no longer drops the pairings.
